about_the_game:
This is a 4K wallpaper collection for the game Law School - Season 1. It includes 40 high-resolution wallpapers created in a non-canonical style, offering a fresh and unique visual experience beyond the main story.

To access the wallpapers:

  • Right-click on Law School - Season 1 in your Steam library.

  • Select Properties.

  • Go to the Installed Files tab.

  • Click Browse.

  • Open the 4k wallpapers folder to find the wallpapers.

content_descriptors.notes: The Wallpapers in this DLC depict partial nudity and display of weapons that might not be suitable for everyone.
